what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Get the Hoppr app Start at the Hoppr download page to get the app. The homepage also links to Hoppr on Telegram and Google Play.
2 Step 2 : Play games in the feed Swipe through the free games and play them regularly. Each game played adds to your Hops, within daily caps that Hoppr does not publish.
3 Step 3 : Keep a daily streak Play every day so the streak multiplier keeps growing. The Hops explainer says a missed day resets it.
4 Step 4 : Complete quests Take on the quests the app offers. The Hops explainer says they vary, from simple daily goals to ones tied to certain game types or creators.
5 Step 5 : Refer new players Invite new players who go on to play. The Hops explainer lists referrals as one of the four ways to earn, and your tier shows in Studio.
